_about: Skill costs (S) for the stat budget v3, 2026-10-18 (owner 19:54: "Triggers and actions are costed by How often x How strong"). Read by tools/skill_costs.js (tools/card_balance.js) and the master hub (Skill costs tab). A keyword skill costs its value (scale fixed), value × its number (scale n; a true payment counts payDefault), or value × (1 + floor(N/2)) for N > 1 (scale half, the old default rule). A trigger entry {on, do} costs trigger weight × action value; the action value is value × its per field (amount / amount2 / count; a missing field counts 1, or 0 when the other one is set), × min(8, targets), × subAll for sub All. Edits from the hub: tools/hub/pull_skill_costs.md.

budget.formula: v5 (2026-10-19 13:52, package BF2): N = (Base + L/levelLinDiv) x (1 + L/levelDiv) for L >= 1, Base - zeroPenalty at Level 0; Base = base + perRarity x Rarity + perWait x W + perWait2 x W^2 + perLumber x Lumber + perLumber2 x Lumber^2 + perRitual x Ritual points + mapCoef x the map where the card becomes obtainable (owner 15:25; canonical/card-obtain-maps.json). levelLinDiv 10 (owner 15:48: let's try L/10; L/5 before). perLevel is v3 (N = Base + perLevel x L), kept for comparisons

triggers.label: On Discard
triggers.note: only when this card is pitched instead of played
triggers.measuredHow: 2026-10-19 (package DC): scenario: the CPU pitches a card a turn; On Discard can only pay resources or rebuild, so it runs as Rebuild 12 (the castle has 100 Health; Rebuild 4 moved nothing) and On Spawn: Rebuild 12 for the weight

triggers.label: On Sacrifice
triggers.note: only when it is given up as fodder or an offering
triggers.measuredHow: 2026-10-19 (package DC): scenario: Devour 3/3 on every copy: the CPU feeds it a hand card (40% of turns), which is sacrificed

triggers.label: On Exile
triggers.note: only when it is moved to the Removal Zone
triggers.measuredHow: 2026-10-19 (package DC): scenario: every copy exiles 2 cards from its graveyard as it is played (On Spawn: Exile from graveyard 2); On Exile can only pay resources or draw, so it runs as Draw 1

triggers.label: On Chain Break
triggers.note: when its Chained breaks
triggers.measuredHow: 2026-10-19 (package DC): scenario: Chained (breaks when the foe plays a unit) on every copy, so every copy breaks free on the foe's next play (live Chained cards break on damage; that version never broke often enough to measure)

triggers.label: On Charge

triggers.measuredHow: 2026-10-19 (package DC): scenario: the Charge skill's own hook: Charge N - deal 2 to a random enemy (N = 1, 2, 3; the weight is at N = 2, as live cards print)

triggers.label: Bounty
triggers.note: owner 2026-10-18: Bounty is worth 0.5. Bounty N = this × Gain × N (you gain N on play, the foe N on its death)
